risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (391.84) with FOMC event just passed creates severe near-term volatility headwind; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset; 33-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with StochRSI bullish cross and 50/200 EMA bullish alignment offer contrarian bounce setup in fear-driven market (VIX crisis), with support at 39.70 providing defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Death cross of 9/21 EMAs, price below both short-term moving averages, failed momentum confirmations (MACD, PSAR, ADX, OBV, Hull), negative CMF, and zero triggered strategies create a bearish structure that overwhelms oversold technicals, compounded by VIX crisis volatility and 33-day earnings event risk.
